component.name: NAM Player
component.summary: Play Neural Amp Modeler profiles and impulse responses live

description.p: NAM Player is a standalone guitar rig for Linux and Windows built on Neural Amp Modeler. Load any .nam model and .wav impulse response from the community, play through it live with a few milliseconds of latency, and shape the sound with a freely reorderable effects chain: tuner, noise gate, compressor, dynamic wah, flanger, phaser, three-band EQ, chorus, tremolo, ping-pong delay, reverb and cab simulation.

A library panel keeps models, IRs and presets one click away, with search, favorites and recents; the TONE3000 tab browses the community catalog with your own account and downloads captures straight into the library. Presets carry the whole rig and remember where their models came from.
Audio goes through JACK or PipeWire on Linux and WASAPI on Windows. NAM Player is an independent project and is not affiliated with the official Neural Amp Modeler plugin.
First public release: reorderable effects chain, library panel, TONE3000 tab, presets, JACK/PipeWire and WASAPI backends.
